mechanism_narrative: A sustained expansion in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) above 137,000 thousand persons indicates robust labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS exceeds 137,000 thousand persons.

mechanism_narrative: A 0.3 percentage point increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) over the past three months signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer confidence and corporate profit expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE rises by 0.3pp or more in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and declines in industrial production (INDPRO) indicate a tightening monetary policy coinciding with weakening economic activity, which triggers a sell-off in equities, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS rises and INDPRO falls in the same month.

mechanism_narrative: During active monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS rising above 4.5% and sustained for 6 months), the S&P 500 tends to underperform as higher discount rates reduce equity valuations, leading to negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods during active monetary tightening cycles.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1500 thousand units signals reduced consumer spending on durable goods and construction, which negatively impacts corporate revenues and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when HOUST is below 1500.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained expansion in industrial production (INDPRO) above 110 (index 2017=100) signals strong manufacturing and supply chain activity that boosts corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO exceeds 110.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year increase in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) above 2.5% signals persistent inflation that prompts the Federal Reserve to raise interest rates, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY change exceeds 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 4.7% within the last month signals immediate economic distress that causes a rapid sell-off in equities, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 4.7%.
